tickets.title: Prepare detailed funds‑flow schedule
tickets.text: Prepare an updated funds‑flow schedule separating gross consideration, escrow holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees for Julian Maplesprocket’s sale, using the draft LOI figures.
tickets.evidence: An updated funds-flow schedule is needed to separate gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare sale‑liquidity staging plan
tickets.text: Prepare a plan showing how incoming business‑sale cash will be allocated among household reserves, tax reserves, renovation funds, debt decisions, and investment tranches for Julian Maplesprocket.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-liquidity staging plan by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Prepare preferred‑equity rollover review
tickets.text: Prepare a plain‑language review of the proposed $1.5 million rollover into Copper Firefly Systems preferred equity, covering liquidity limits, dividend terms, redemption rights, and concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that preferred-equity rollover review by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA sale‑tax projection package
tickets.text: Prepare a tax projection package covering federal, Oregon, basis, installment‑payment assumptions, escrow taxation, and shareholder note treatment for Julian’s sale.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Model shareholder note payoff treatment
tickets.text: Model the $380,000 shareholder note payoff separately from equity proceeds to aid advisory team and CPA in cash‑allocation assumptions.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to model the shareholder note payoff treatment by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Clarify employee retention bonus pool
tickets.text: Clarify the variance in the employee retention bonus pool figures to determine impact on net proceeds and working‑capital adjustments.
tickets.evidence: Clarification of the retention bonus pool variance is needed by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare escrow holdback reserve analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a reserve scenario that excludes escrow release proceeds for the liquidity plan, analyzing escrow holdback impacts.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the escrow holdback reserve analysis by 2025-01-13.

tickets.title: Verify incoming‑wire capacity and instructions
tickets.text: Verify the receiving‑bank process and capacity for the expected sale proceeds inbound wire before funds are sent.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions by 2025-01-02.

tickets.title: Obtain final consulting agreement economics
tickets.text: Obtain the final consulting agreement terms covering compensation, expense reimbursement, termination, and non‑compete interactions for Julian’s post‑sale income forecast.
tickets.evidence: Final consulting agreement economics are needed by 2025-01-09.

tickets.title: Prepare post‑sale investment policy
tickets.text: Prepare an investment policy reflecting staged cash deployment, liquidity floor, tax exposure, and fossil‑fuel screening preferences after the business sale.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the post-sale investment policy by 2025-01-22.

tickets.title: Prepare renovation and mortgage reserve model
tickets.text: Model renovation costs and mortgage reserve needs to determine how much sale cash can be allocated to property spending, considering the Portland residence and lake cabin debts.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling by 2025-01-16.

tickets.title: Review insurance transition after sale
tickets.text: Review changes to Julian and Priya’s insurance coverage, including term life, disability, umbrella, and key‑person policies, in light of the business‑sale liquidity shift.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to review the insurance transition after the business sale by 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Complete estate liquidity and fiduciary review
tickets.text: Complete a review of estate liquidity and fiduciary considerations given the increased liquidity from the sale and current family circumstances.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review by 2025-01-17.

tickets.title: Prepare residency and sourcing support file
tickets.text: Prepare a residency and sourcing support file for the CPA’s sale‑year tax analysis, documenting travel, Washington apartment stays, and Oregon workdays.
tickets.evidence: Julian’s travel calendar, Oregon workdays, and Washington apartment records create a concrete need for a residency and sourcing support file for the CPA’s sale-year tax analysis by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding structure comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of charitable funding structures, including donor‑advised funds and appreciated securities, using the family’s $75,000 annual giving level and projected sale liquidity.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the charitable funding structure comparison by 2025-01-14.
